datasets.title: Honduras Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 1.6 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 78% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 2 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 1% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and validated against AI-mapped estimates, achieving approximately 78% coverage of total buildings in Honduras. Data were exported in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for accessibility.
